name: Andrzej Halicki, Matjaž Nemec - Après le § 35 - Am 118
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2026
part_text: 35 a. Requests that at least EUR 1 million be allocated from the appropriations for the "Citizens, Equality, Rights and Values" programme to create a new priority and new actions within the "European Remembrance" initiative dedicated to remembering the crimes of communism within the Union, so that the ravages caused by this ideology are never forgotten and the younger generations are informed about them;
